extend_action_space: extend the HabitatSimActions singleton action space by registering a new action name and returning its integer id
has_action: check if a named action is already registered in the HabitatSimActions singleton action space
get_action_id: get the integer id for a registered action name using attribute or bracket access on HabitatSimActions
iterate_actions: iterate over all registered action names in the HabitatSimActions singleton using its iterator protocol
count_actions: get the total number of registered actions in the HabitatSimActions singleton using len()
